uncertainty: One explicit audited reconstruction, not an exact hidden-voxel recovery. Perspective photographs lack complete orthographic layers, measurements of overall height and interior placement.

Printed8x13 arrows interpreted as complete four-wheel outer envelope; center-to-center interpretation would yield a different vehicle size. Exact original arrow attachment not unambiguously recoverable from perspective. Printed13x4 platform footprint prioritized alongside these arrows.

Complete structural envelope8x10x13 excludes front/rear thin signs/buttons, whose occupied matrix cells extend z0..14, making artifact8x10x15. Main body width6, floor width4, tire diameter3/depth2 and roof height10 are inferred, not printed callouts.

Platform construction-stage13x4=52 black-concrete cells is exact as an initial step. Final next-step grille replaces4 front edge cells and rear yellow sill replaces4 rear edge cells, leaving44 of the original52 black-concrete platform cells. No hidden duplicate blocks under replacements.
Tire corner stair shapes/halves and lodestone face placement, wheel-to-axle offset, raised twin wall posts and slab undersides inferred. Visual fidelity is not guaranteed by binary validation.

Body/window heights, hood setbacks, side entry and ladder location, rear double-door width/hinges, roof ring/corners and warning bracket placement inferred. No omitted optional side door invented, and no powered mechanism.

Glow/ordinary item-frame headlights/tail lights are omitted under no-entities rule, leaving bare yellow corners. This is an explicit visual mismatch, not an implementation of the book lights. Blank signs have no lettering/glowing text. No replacement blocks for frames.

Interior integrated from roof-off cutaway: exact seat count, purpur-stair orientation, colored carpet boundaries and handrail lengths inferred. Roof remains installed; no separate duplicate interior build.

No live server, physics, neighbor-update, accessibility/climbing, vehicle movement, warning-beacon flashing or redstone-operation claims. Parked decorative bus. Furnace/sign content NBT intentionally absent; no entities/fluids/complex NBT.
